summary: AXIA Energia S.A., a Brazilian electric utility, filed a Form 6-K with the SEC to announce the commencement of a public offering of 500,000 simple, non-convertible, unsecured debentures under an automatic registration procedure with CVM. The issuance totals R$500,000,000 (500 million Brazilian reais) with a unit par value of R$1,000. Coordinators include BTG Pactual Investment Banking and XP Investimentos. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction akin to an SEC-registered debt takedown, not a special situation. There is no change of control, restructuring, or strategic event; it is a standard financing activity.
